page_title: GroAsk - The AI Command Center for macOS

sources.entry: GroAsk - Menu bar launcher that sends selected text to AI assistants and CLI agents.

summary.name: GroAsk
summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app that launches AI assistants and CLI coding agents (mainly Claude Code) via a global hotkey and monitors Claude Code session cost and context usage.
keywords: run claude code from menu bar
use_cases: Launch Claude Code in project directories from a hotkey
Monitor cost and context usage of multiple Claude Code sessions
Send selected text from any app to an AI assistant
Get notified when an agent is waiting for approval
Switch quickly between CLI agents and web AI chats
summary.what_it_does: GroAsk is a macOS menu bar app for launching and monitoring AI agents. Its dashboard shows, for each Claude Code session, real-time cost, elapsed time, context percentage, model, and latest agent output, and clicking a card jumps to that terminal. It installs a hook into Claude Code's event system that writes status files, which the app watches via FSEvents. A launcher opened with ⌥Space lets you type a task to start Claude Code or other CLI agents in chosen workspaces across Terminal, iTerm2, Ghostty, or Warp. Select & Ask captures selected text (via simulated Cmd+C) and sends it to a chosen AI, and it can also paste images into web AI sites.
notable: Real-time Claude Code session dashboard with cost, context % and Plan Usage quota bar
Select & Ask global hotkey sends selected text to 10 AIs, with Tab to switch targets
Auto-installs Claude Code hooks; uses FSEvents instead of polling
Supports four terminals: Terminal, iTerm2, Ghostty, Warp
caveats: Dashboard currently monitors only Claude Code; other CLI agents are on the roadmap
Requires macOS 13+ and Accessibility permission for Select & Ask and image paste
Web AI channels require Google Chrome and enabling a JavaScript-from-Apple-Events setting
Early access; the page lists a $19.9 price crossed out next to $0, and says it is currently free
